title: Snoring (Meme)
blurb: Deep, theatrical, and communicating exactly one message: this has become unbearable. The meme snore is a performance rather than a sound — nobody asleep has ever snored with this much intention — and that is why it functions as a review. Play it during long stories with no visible destination, meetings that could have been emails, and anybody explaining their fantasy football league to a person who did not ask. It is the polite society version of standing up and leaving. The snorer is asleep; the message is entirely awake.
origin: The theatrical bored-snore of meme culture.
